checks.name: interface declares handle mutators
checks.detail: IAudioManager must expose handle-based stop, position, volume, and parameter application

checks.name: miniaudio manager stores playable handles
checks.detail: PlayEvent must assign caller-visible handles and retain the active ma_sound by handle

checks.name: stop applies handle to active sound
checks.detail: StopEvent must look up the requested handle and stop that ma_sound

checks.name: immediate stop releases active handle
checks.detail: Immediate StopEvent must uninitialize the ma_sound and erase the active handle

checks.name: stop removes spatial cluster source
checks.detail: Stopping a 3D handle must remove the matching spatial cluster source

checks.name: position applies handle to ma_sound
checks.detail: SetEventPosition must apply the handle position to miniaudio and spatial clustering

checks.name: volume applies handle to ma_sound
checks.detail: SetEventVolume must apply caller volume to the handle and keep the spatial source in sync

checks.name: parameter applies supported miniaudio controls
checks.detail: SetEventParameter must apply supported per-handle controls instead of always failing

checks.name: unknown handles are rejected
checks.detail: Handle mutators must return false when the handle is not active
